title: iCor's SMP Core
description: Professional Minecraft Paper 1.21.x SMP Core Plugin with modular architecture, MySQL support, player data system, async saving, command framework, API layer and scalable backend systems.
body:
# SMPCore

Professional Minecraft Paper 1.21.x SMP Core Plugin built for scalable Survival Multiplayer servers.

SMPCore provides a clean, modular and production-ready backend foundation for serious SMP projects.
Designed for large community servers, custom survival networks and expandable server infrastructures.

This is not a basic utility plugin.

This is a full premium Core System.

---

# Features

## Core Systems

* Professional modular architecture
* Bootstrap system
* Service Registry
* Module Loader
* Shutdown Handler
* Async-safe backend structure
* Performance optimized systems
* MySQL support
* SQLite fallback
* Optional Vault Hook
* Optional LuckPerms Hook

---

## Player Systems

* PlayerData management
* UUID-based storage
* Player cache system
* Async loading and saving
* Auto-save tasks
* Playtime tracking
* Coins system
* Statistics tracking
* Homes system
* Spawn system

---

## Teleport Systems

* TPA requests
* TPA Here requests
* Accept / Deny requests
* Auto TPA accept
* Toggle TPA requests
* Teleport warmup system
* Cooldown support

---

## Home Systems

* Set homes
* Delete homes
* Home GUI support
* Home list system
* Unlimited homes support via permissions

---

## Admin Systems

* Spawn management
* Config reload system
* Protection bypass systems
* Cooldown bypass
* Combat bypass
* Warmup bypass
* Full administrative control

---

# Permissions

## Admin Permission

### smpcore.admin

Full administrative access to all major systems.

Includes:

* smpcore.reload
* smpcore.setspawn
* smpcore.player.other
* smpcore.bypass.*
* smpcore.homes.unlimited

---

## Individual Permissions

### smpcore.reload

Allows reloading plugin configuration.

### smpcore.setspawn

Allows setting the global server spawn.

### smpcore.player.other

Allows viewing data of other players.

### smpcore.bypass.cooldown

Bypass command cooldown restrictions.

### smpcore.bypass.protection

Bypass protection systems.

### smpcore.bypass.combat

Bypass combat tag restrictions.

### smpcore.bypass.warmup

Bypass teleport warmup delays.

### smpcore.homes.unlimited

Removes home limits for players.

---

# Built For

Perfect for:

* SMP Networks
* Community Survival Servers
* Professional Minecraft Projects
* Custom Server Infrastructure
* Large Scale Multiplayer Systems

---

# Technical Stack

* Java 21
* Paper API 1.21.11
* MySQL
* SQLite
* HikariCP
* Optional Redis support
* Vault support
* LuckPerms support

---

# Installation

1. Install Paper 1.21.11
2. Put SMPCore into your plugins folder
3. Start the server
4. Configure database.yml
5. Restart the server
6. Enjoy actual good architecture

---

# Status
